name: ilot
description: Îlot : outil interne de réservation de bureaux (flex office), projet portfolio

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ilot/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @ilot/api" "npm run start -w @ilot/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ilot/shared && npm run build -w @ilot/api && npm run build -w @ilot/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @ilot/shared && npm run test -w @ilot/api && npm run test -w @ilot/web
